macro_cross_check: Ours (4-serving source basis, all 17 lines costed): 679 cal / 44.2 g protein / 33.5 g carbs per serving. Source published 643 cal / 41 P / 32 C. Protein +8% and calories +5.6% - both inside tolerance, so the 500 g of chicken (2 large breasts at 250 g) is the right portion. TWO THINGS TO WATCH: our 679 cal is ABOVE this run's 650 ceiling even though the source's own 643 sits just under it, and our 33.5 g carbs is only 1.5 g under the 35 g cap - the honey, balsamic, peaches and glazed almonds together carry 117 g of the 134 g of carbs, so any upward revision of the almonds or peaches pushes it over. Both are screening calls for the orchestrator, not mapping defects.
